description: ZIMPOL is the visible Zurich Imaging Polarimeter inside SPHERE, used for imaging and imaging polarimetry from about 500 to 900 nm. These are the ZIMPOL filters and neutral densities on ESO's filter page.
facility_description: SPHERE is the VLT high-contrast imager at Paranal; ZIMPOL is its visible science camera.
notes: NJM's info.json for SPHERE/ZIMPOL records no curve URL. Central wavelengths and widths are copied from the ESO ZIMPOL tables. The page also lists an Ha_NB filter with no transmission file; it is not an NJM band. Schmid et al. 2018 is the ZIMPOL system paper. No magnitude system is stated on the filter page.
